wins.text: Q4 total net inflows of ~$96 billion; November and December alone generated 6% annualized organic base fee growth, the best momentum since 2021

Industry-leading ETF net inflows of $186 billion in 2023, including $112 billion into bond ETFs and $70 billion from European iShares; #1 share of European ETF market where industry flows rose 70% YoY
Q4 EPS of $9.66, up 8% YoY; full-year EPS of $37.77, up 7% YoY; Q4 operating income of $1.7 billion, up 9% YoY

Announced acquisition of GIP — world's leading independent infrastructure manager with $100B+ client AUM — creating a $150B combined infrastructure platform, nearly doubling private markets management fees to over $1.5B and adding $400M+ in post-tax annual FRE at margins above 50%
Returned over $4.5 billion to shareholders in 2023 via dividends and buybacks; Board declared 2% dividend increase to $5.10/share quarterly; targeting $1.5B in share repurchases in 2024

risks.text: Full-year operating margin of 41.7% declined 110 bps YoY, pressured by negative market/FX impact on entry-rate revenue and elevated investment in people and technology
Full-year and Q4 retail net outflows of $8B and $9B respectively, driven by redemptions from liquid alternatives and flexible bond funds amid rising-rate sensitivity
Institutional index net outflows of $55B in 2023 driven by large client redemptions from low-fee equity strategies for cash needs or allocation shifts
Q4 restructuring charge of $61M and onetime compensation expense of $28M impacting ~3% of workforce; integration and transaction costs from GIP deal could weigh on near-term reported results

Uncertainty around timing of money market fund rotation into risk assets; historical data does not clearly support a large-scale re-risking cycle, and higher-for-longer rates could delay the anticipated $7T+ redeployment

guidance_items.detail: Entered Q1 2024 with estimated base fee run rate ~6% higher than Q4 total base fees, reflecting accelerating organic growth and market appreciation at year-end
Committed to delivering a premium operating margin and operating leverage over time; GIP transaction expected to be modestly accretive to as-adjusted operating margin in first full year post-close
GIP transaction expected to be modestly accretive to as-adjusted EPS in first full year post-close, excluding transaction-related costs

Reaffirmed 5% or better through-the-cycle organic base fee growth target; ACV growth target of low-to-mid teens maintained; headcount expected broadly flat in 2024 ex-GIP; core G&A expected to grow low-to-mid single digits in 2024 ex-GIP
Tax rate estimated at ~25% for 2024; $1.5B share repurchase target for 2024

analyst_concerns_not_in_prepared: Historical data does not clearly support large-scale rotation from money market funds into risk assets in past Fed cycles — analysts pressed on what makes this cycle different
Specific 2023 FRE figure for GIP (management declined to disclose, only referenced 2024 forward estimates)
Detailed economics of GIP performance fees and carried interest split for future funds (40% BlackRock / 60% GIP) not proactively disclosed in prepared remarks
